notes.title: ENGAGE v4.1.1 Patch
notes.notes:
FIXED

Fixed an issue where GLB files in snapshots or experiences can be positioned incorrectly
Fixed an issue where GLB files may not display textures correctly
Fixed an issue where animated GLBs did not auto-start their animation
Fixed an issue where the Emoji reactions text appeared below the menu in 'Session Settings'

notes.title: ENGAGE - Update to v4.1
notes.notes:
NEWAI
AI Characters made in the AI Character Builder that use ‘Chat Completions’ can now use Functions. This allows for Athena-style capabilities at much faster processing speeds. 

Added a Session Setting and an individual user setting to allow hosts to manage who can talk to AI characters in the session. 

Added a Group Setting that allows AI Character Builder to be accessed by group Members, and not just group Owners & Admins. 

Added a new function: Web search – allows the AI bot to search the web in real-time to find answers to questions. 

Added a new function: Create 3D Mesh – support for Meshy.ai to be able to generate an original, fully textured 3D model.

Added a new function: Load specific IFX.

Added the ability for an AI Character to continue to be able to have a conversation with the user while Generative AI is processing.

Added a new function: Ability for the AI to trigger Experience triggers.

Added an ‘AI Command’ IFX to the Experience Editor so that an Experience can send commands to the nearest AI character, allow the character to ‘spontaneously’ respond to actions the user takes within an Experience. 

Added Experimental non-English language support.
Other
Haptic and Audio feedback on the Virtual Keyboard.

Hosts can push a whiteboard drawing to all users' ‘My Drawpad’ tab on their personal Drawpads.

Applied the movement UI seen on the Drawpad to the Virtual Keyboard and the Mixed Reality Window. 

Added more information to the Activity Logs.
IMPROVED
Whiteboards no longer display the 'Draw' button when you point at them if you're connected to them via your Drawpad. 

Introduced an improved GLB/GLTF model importer that is faster and more performant.

Declining Spatial and Storage permissions does not prevent you from accessing the application.
FIXED
Fixed an issue where the virtual keyboard failed to register key presses in the Experience Editor. 

Fixed an issue where users with no IFX permissions were able to spawn video cameras if they have access to the Recordings menu.

Fixed an issue where saving an Assistants API bot in the AI Character Builder that use Files can cause the 'Files' function to be disabled. 

Fixed an issue where subgroup integrations don’t successfully verify users.

notes.title: v4.0.1 Patch Release
notes.notes:
Minor patch release:

 Fixed an issue with headset tracking on Meta Quest Link.

notes.title: ENGAGE - Update to v4.0
notes.notes:
NEW
- Added a new, full-featured personal drawing pad to facilitate both private and collaborative drawing.
- Added support for the Logitech MX Ink stylus for users of Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest 3S headsets. This includes left and right handed use for drawing on surfaces, adjusting line style in response to applied pressure, drawing in the air with the 3D pen, and navigating through ENGAGE.
- Added host settings to control whether Drawpads are available in a session and whether non-hosts can connect their Drawpad to a whiteboard.
- Added the ability for the drawings on a whiteboard to be captured in a spatial recording.
- Added the ability to connect whiteboards together, so that anything drawn on one whiteboard is mirrored to another.
- Redesigned the tool panel used when drawing on a whiteboard in VR.
- Added the new Drawpad as the interface when using a whiteboard on a desktop device.
- Added the ability to capture a 2D video recording from either an avatar's point of view or the view from a camera IFX. Users can add multiple camera IFX and switch between capture sources during the recording.
- Added the ability to press the Z key or middle mouse button on desktop devices to toggle between looking around and interacting with the environment.
- Added the ability to press the B key to toggle the visibility of IFX bubbles.
- Introduced limits on the number of LITE users that can join some types of session.
- Added commercial sessions. These are like persistent sessions, but don t limit the number of LITE users that can join.
- Added an indicator on the in-session menu that shows the LITE user limit and how many are currently in the session.
- Made the ability to lock a session an Enterprise-only feature.
- Added a host control to turn off the ability for users to open a mixed reality passthrough window.
- Renamed the Content Editor to the Experience Editor. The files that users create in the Experience Editor are now called Experiences.


IMPROVED
- Reduced the space requirements when a host summons users in a session and set all users to be summoned to the same point.
- Enabled users on VR devices to use the trigger button to select UI elements at close range. Previously, tapping was the only way to select UI elements at close range.
- Updated the default ElevenLabs voice to a more recent model. Users can override it with their own selection.
- Changed the server that bug reports are sent to so that users on more restricted networks can still log bugs.
- Adjusted the selectable area for delete and lock buttons to better match the boundary of the button graphics and prevent accidental selection.


FIXED
- Fixed 2FA code entry so that users on desktop devices can submit with the return key and users on VR devices can submit with the return button on the virtual keyboard. 
- Fixed the moving seats that are used in some vehicle IFX.
- Fixed the ability to replace the audio in a spatial recording.
- Fixed an issue that could cause no screens to be detected when a user attempted to share their desktop.
- Fixed an issue that caused a user's credentials to be rejected the first time they tried to log in to ENGAGE after they registered for an account in the web manager.
- Fixed the ability to use the X button to close the application without experiencing a delay.
- Fixed an issue with PCVR that caused a user to lose hand tracking if the ENGAGE application window lost focus.

notes.title: ENGAGE - Update to v3.10.1
notes.notes:
NEW 
- Added new session settings to give non-host users permission to change the location and load content. 

IMPROVED
- Filtered AI character responses to remove the # symbol and prevent unintended shouting. 

FIXED
- Fixed an issue that could cause a location to appear as only a black screen when a user joined a session. 
- Fixed an issue that prevented users from joining a passworded persistent session.  
- Fixed an issue that caused standard sessions to remain visible in the public listing after all users left. 
- Fixed an issue that could cause an outfit override to be applied outside of the designated region. 
- Fixed an issue that could cause a user's avatar to not be visible in a session. 
- Fixed the haptic feedback that occurs when two avatar hands collide. 
- Fixed image uploads for the My Face service.
- Fixed an issue that prevented users on VR devices from selecting buttons in content. 
- Fixed an issue that could cause some objects in a piece of content to not appear for some users.

notes.title: ENGAGE - Update to v3.10
notes.notes:
NEW
- Enabled the use of both hand controllers to interact with menus.
- Enabled VR users to type on the virtual keyboard by tapping keys with their hand controllers.
- Implemented quick links to speed up access to sessions.
- Added an option to the Invite panel in a session for users to copy a quick link to the session.
- Added new languages for voice recognition when interacting with AI characters.
- Added processing to remove special characters included in text returned by AI services to prevent them from being verbalized.
- Added a subfolder named AI-Generated to the Images folder, where images generated by AI services will be saved.
- Added an option for users to empty their recycle bin and permanently delete the files.
- Updated to Unity 2022.3.
- Replaced the teleport sit marker with a higher resolution, language-neutral version, and moved the ghost seat closer to the actual seat position.
- Removed the head-tracking gaze cursor that appeared when hand tracking was lost.
- Prevented LITE users from being made co-hosts in a session, to improve security.
- Fixed event creation by PLUS users to prevent the overbooking warning from appearing unnecessarily.
- Ensured that midnight appears as 00:00 instead of 24:00 in event listings.
- Fixed an issue with scalable events so that if a user leaves and rejoins an event, they join the first instance that has capacity.
- Fixed an issue in scalable events that caused the user count on the in-session menu to be incorrect.
- Fixed an issue that could cause user input to stop registering in the personal web browser on Quest headsets.
- Fixed muting on VR headsets to ensure that if a user was unmuted before they entered away mode, they are unmuted when they return.
- Fixed the option to mute LITE users so that non-LITE users aren't also affected.
- Fixed the notification when a host requests that a user unmutes their microphone.
- Fixed the ability to place the text cursor (caret) at a specific position in a text field when using hand controllers.
- Fixed an issue that prevented users from downloading camera images after they uploaded them to Cloud File Manager.
- Fixed the display of feedback to a user if they attempt to play a YouTube video through an invalid URL.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the visibility icons to not be shown in the Content Editor curves view.

notes.title: ENGAGE - Update to v3.9.1
notes.notes:
FIXED
- Fixed the menu buttons on the VR tablet to reduce the distance at which they’re activated.
- Fixed an issue that limited the areas in which a host could use the Summon All tool.
- Fixed the ability to enter a spawn point name in a Session Portal IFX.
- Fixed an issue with key responsiveness on the virtual keyboard when used in the Content Editor.
- Fixed an issue that could cause changes to start and end times made in the Content Editor Effect Options panel to not be saved when an object was edited for the first time.
- Fixed an issue that prevented cloud file videos with an obsolete CDN address from playing in ENGAGE.
- Fixed the appearance of the file format dialog that appears when a user plays a video from cloud files.

notes.title: Release Notes v3.9
notes.notes:
NEW
- Launched the School of AI - where users can talk with 20 different historical figures whose lives spanned from the ancient world to the US civil rights era. As part of the launch, all ENGAGE users will have access to the School of AI during the month of October. To arrange access after this time, please contact sales.
- Replaced the keyboard that appears for VR users with a version that has an improved layouts for each language, custom layouts for specific input types, easier access to common keys and commands, and can be repositioned in 3D space.
- Set events that are associated with a persistent session to automatically start at the designated time. This removes the need for an event organizer to manually start the event. The event will also automatically be removed from the event list at the designated end time.
- Added an option for hosts to set all users who are in a session, or join later, to appear as basic avatars.
- Updated session creation so that all sessions created by a member of an Enterprise group are owned by an Enterprise group. This enables Enterprise features and services to be available in standard Sessions.
- Added the ability to replace the public list of outfit options with a custom collection for a specific Enterprise group.

IMPROVED
- Increased the maximum resolution for YouTube videos to 1080p in standard locations and 4k in UHD locations.
- Implemented progressive download of outfit thumbnails to reduce the possibility that a slow connection will cause the application to become unresponsive.
- Replaced gender labels with body shape options in the avatar editor.
- Implemented a more efficient process to distribute audio returned by text-to-speech services. For example, when users interact with an AI agent.
- Set persistent sessions to reset their location to the ENGAGE Hub if there is an error loading the current location. 
- Updated the location anchor to appear in front of a user when they choose to reset their anchor's placement.
- Standardized the presentation of dates and times shown in the application.
- Improved consistency in the sequence of dialogs that a user may see when they join a plaza from the ENGAGE LINK map.

FIXED
- Fixed the display of 2D 360 YouTube videos.
- Fixed an issue that caused users who joined a session after a YouTube video was muted to still hear the audio.
- Fixed support for YouTube videos loaded through a /live or /short URL.
- Fixed an issue that could cause some users in a session to not hear an AI character's responses.
- Fixed an issue that caused Remember Me settings to be lost when a user lost their network connection during use of the application.
- Fixed an issue that could prevent a user from changing their height when they used imperial units.
- Fixed an issue that could cause an avatar to appear in the wrong pose and position when it first loads in a session.
- Fixed an issue that caused a height entered as 5 ft. to be displayed as 4 ft. 12 in.
- Fixed an issue that caused the attendees and interested counts to show as zero when events were viewed on the Attending or Interested tabs of the Events page.
- Fixed an issue that could cause a user's microphone to cut out if they were recording and had an unstable network connection.
- Fixed an issue that could cause a warning about recording more than five users to appear when less than five users were selected.
- Fixed an issue that could cause host and microphone icons to be incorrectly positioned within a user's nameplate.
- Fixed the button to leave the mixed reality room and set up room space that appears when a user s device isn't fully set up to use mixed reality.
- Fixed an issue that could prevent a user from being able to log in when their device used the Hijri calendar.
- Fixed the tooltip text on the session creation screen.
- Fixed an issue that caused the in-session microphone icon's visibility to be turned off after a change in location.

notes.title: V2.0 Release
notes.notes:
New

New Avatar System - Version 2.0 of ENGAGE brings an entirely new avatar system built from scratch with many new features and improvements
o Better tracking, locomotion, and body movement
o A garment filter system to allow you to quickly find the right clothing for your occasion
o Additional selections of all types of clothing
o Enhanced decal options
o A wide-ranging new color palette selection for all types of apparel
o Enhanced facial customization 
o Additional hairstyle options, eyebrow styling and color choices
o New make-up and nail polish range with opacity and gloss option
o Up to 10 full body avatars on standalone VR devices
o Mobile avatar preview option
o A new mirror mode lets you “be” your avatar as you create it
o New enhanced avatar seating system allowing custom poses and predefined poses for specific apparel types
o Much more


New Locations
o Hospital
o Virtual Campus


Cloud File Manager - Enterprise Only
o Users now can save and upload any files to the cloud that are created inside ENGAGE
o They also can upload and manage multiple types of media files & use them inside an ENGAGE session
o NOTE – Access to this new beta feature will be limited for initial rollout to approved beta testers only for now. 



IMPROVED

Gizmo Feature Enhancement
o Snap to ground function has an updated interface design with a dedicated snap to ground arrow
o Increment snapping mode has a magnet mode which provides better increment snapping control for both position and rotation. This can be further fine-tuned with sensitivity controls.
o Additional input modes allow you to adjust movements using Analog sticks and mouse wheel commands
o Optimized interaction for better performance and usability


Voice in Session
o System and software upgrades for improved service and stability


Security and Performance
o Important updates and improvements that benefits the stability of the platform


Content Editor
o Many small improvements to UX and UI
o Recordings can now be edited to force full body for selected users
o Several improvements to content and SDK features


FIXED

Recording Playback Issues
o Minor fixes to recording playback issues


Voice In Session
o Several fixes for user voice when connecting and disconnecting during session, losing audio when changing location and when using headphones


Whiteboards
o Fixed issue with whiteboards where they were not visible to some users


Media Player
o A number of issues have been fixed for displaying slides, zooming, media volume and video display issues

notes.title: ENGAGE Version 1.2
notes.notes:
New Features & Improvements

New Host Controls
      o	Give other users in the session co-host powers, so they can control media, IFX, recording and all other things the Host can do. 
      o	Remove or ban users from a live session or event.
      o	Give other users in a session the ability to set IFX to “Shared”. 

Sticky Notes
      o	Create sticky notes and place them anywhere inside training and experiences. In the lecture hall location, snap these sticky notes to the blackboard.   

Shared IFX
      o	Users can now change a setting on their IFX objects in a location to “Shared”, which allows other users in the session to move, rotate, scale or delete that IFX. 

IFX – Enhanced Controls
      o	Move, position, rotate and scale IFX 3D models with more precision using the advanced control gizmos.  

Hide IFX user interface in location
      o	Setting to turn on or off IFX user interface (Spheres, buttons etc) so users have a more immersive experience.  

Advanced Recording Controls
      o	A selection of advanced options for playing back recordings.  

Session Settings 
      o	Increased the max number of users per session from 35 to 50.
      o	ENTERPRISE users can now set live sessions to be visible for their Group only. 

Avatars 
      o	Updated visual appearance for Android OS devices such as Oculus Quest. 
      o	Added more uniforms and hair color options.

General Fixes and Optimizations
      o	Optimized loading speed for many parts of the¬¬ software, especially on launch. 
      o	Optimized stability and performance, with a focus on video, networking & memory.
      o	Minor bugs and user interface improvements.


New Content

Location – Theatre
      o	A grand stage with curtains, controls for lighting, screens and podiums. 

Location – Courtroom
      o	A courtroom for live or recorded legal training and experiences.

notes.title: ENGAGE Version 1.0
notes.notes:
ENGAGE Version 1.0 is here!

New Features

•    My Face – Now you can upload a photo of your own face and have a 3D face generated automatically with lifelike detail!

•    Events & Scheduling – Schedule an Event inside ENGAGE or within the ENGAGE Web App at app.engagevr.io. People can also browse publicly listed events and show interest or indicate they will be attending. Events can be pre-planned in advance using the web application or within the ENGAGE main application.

•    Forms – Create quizzes, surveys, feedback forms and more to deliver to users who are attending your room sessions or viewing your recordings and content.

•    Premium – For a nominal monthly fee now users can upgrade to Premium/Pro user and get access to extra content and enhanced functionality inside ENGAGE.

1.    High-Rise Loft
2.    Circular Conference Hall
3.    Executive Conference Room
4.    Repair Shop
5.    Virtual Shop

These new features come with several enhancements and bugfixes to ENGAGE and a lot more to discover once you get inside!

Don’t forget you can create and manage your account and more ENGAGE features including notes, forms, media, and events from right inside the web app. Head over to app.engagevr.io to see what is possible.

Enjoy!
engage-team@immersivevreducation.com

notes.title: ENGAGE 0.6 Update
notes.notes:
Hello ENGAGE users! 

Today we have an update for you that incorporates several new features and bugfixes.
 
Here are some highlights: 

- New Feature: Desktop Sharing – Share your desktop screen and present documents and content from any application on your desktop to everyone else in the session! 

- New Feature: Cloud Files – Within My Media inside ENGAGE or the web application, you can now connect to several cloud providers including OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox to load directly into shared media screens. 

- New Feature: Laser Pointer – The host and media assistant now have a laser pointer that can be used to point things out to others at any time. The laser pointer is activated by holding the grip and trigger buttons on either hand in VR. 

- New Feature: Advanced tracking – Hips and feet can now be tracked along with the standard hands and head. Just enter ENGAGE with Vive trackers on your feet and/or hips and you will be prompted to calibrate once inside. Advanced tracking is fully compatible with the recording system and all other functions. 

- CDN - ENGAGE now uses a worldwide Content Delivery Network to speed up downloading times for all content updates inside the application. 

- Improved network - The networking in ENGAGE has been significantly improved in this build with a new dedicated streaming channel to handle all the web and desktop streaming functions. VOIP will no longer be affected by streaming usage. 

- Set Seated Position – You can now set / re-center your real-world chair position to anywhere you like on SteamVR and Oculus. A quick link to this function can be found on the menu home page. 

- Improved Avatars - All avatars and the avatar IK system have been improved significantly in this build and will continue to improve. 

- Live-input Keyboard - All web-based menus and the browser now have a virtual live-input text keyboard to make taking notes, web browsing, and general usage of ENGAGE in VR much easier. 

- Several more bugfixes and general improvements have been made in this build. Thank you for the support and feedback!

notes.title: ENGAGE 0.5 update
notes.notes:
Hi ENGAGE users,

We know it's been a while since the last update but the wait is finally over! We have a great update for you today, and there is much more to come soon as we get closer to the beta release.

Release Highlights:

- New ENGAGE web application ( https://www.engagevr.io ) and user accounts where you can create notes, quizzes, and access all-new account features as they become available.

- Brand new scalable avatar system built from the ground up by our talented team of artists and designers.

- New IFX and location menus with filters and search queries to find what you need faster.

- More control over your recordings. Select exactly who to record, whether that is just yourself, a group of presenters, or everyone.

- New User Management menu where the host can manipulate options for others in their settings, including shared IFX sessions where others can join in the creation.

- New Feature: IFX Snapshots – Save a snapshot of all of the IFX you or everyone has created and load them anywhere, at any time. Mix and match, combine, or edit snapshots to create even more immersive environments.

- New Feature: Media Assistant – The host can now allow one other user in the session at a time to load and control websites or to load and share control of videos with the host.

- New Feature: Recording Assistant – The host can now allow one other user in the session at a time to record using the recording feature.

- New Feature: Quizzes – Create quizzes, tests and questionnaires and deliver them live and recorded within Engage.

- New Feature: Engage Content Creator: The same tool we use to create most of the content you see inside Engage is now in closed alpha testing. Please contact us to become a test user.

- New Feature: Notes – Create and view notes inside the Engage web application or inside Engage.

- Several bugfixes, stability improvements, and much more.



Thank you all for your support, your feedback is appreciated!

engage-team@immersivevreducation.com
